description: Check a soundboard's soundboardio.json manifest like the SoundBoardio validator does. Give the GitHub repository, or the manifest text to check it before pushing. Returns every check with its status (error, warning, tip or ok), message and line in the manifest, and the board url.

manifest.description: The soundboardio.json text, to check it before it is pushed. With repo, the repository name is checked too.

repo.description: The board repository: https://github.com/<owner>/soundboardio-<name>, <owner>/soundboardio-<name> or the board url on soundboardio.com.

name: validate_board
title: Validate a soundboard
